logline: Every missed penalty flies out of the TV: Ronaldo's into the popcorn, Mbappé's through the ceiling — Yamal laughs both times, then his own miss rolls out to Ronaldo and Mbappé, and he must climb out of the TV for it.

beats.idea: TV: Ronaldo hits the post, the ball flies at the camera and cracks the TV glass
Ronaldo blames himself behind the cracked glass
sofa: the ball pops out of the TV into the popcorn; popcorn all over Mbappé; Yamal laughs
Mbappé stands, popcorn falling off: for my idol
the ball crashes through the ceiling onto Mbappé's empty seat; Yamal laughs lying on the sofa
TV: Yamal takes Raphinha's ball, winks at the camera, shanks it toward us
ball rolls out to Ronaldo + Mbappé: look, high-five, laugh; Yamal climbs out of the TV for his ball

twist: the ball that rolls out of the TV is Yamal's — and he has to climb out of the TV to ask for it
callback: the HEHEHE comes back from the other side of the sofa; the TV crack from 0:01 stays on every later TV shot
hidden_details: the crack from Ronaldo's ball stays on the TV for the rest of the video
the popcorn is gone after the ceiling crash
the HEHEHE grows one HE each time
meme_frame: Yamal crying, climbing out of the TV, while Ronaldo and Mbappé laugh
hook_frame0: cover: the three on the sofa, WHO LAUGHS LAST?
